displayName: Dream synthetic loop: two consecutive failures

documentation.content: The synthetic dream loop failed at least twice consecutively. Inspect counts-only Dream canary stage/error_type logs on backend-sync. See backend/docs/runbooks/dream-agent.md. Bind the environment's approved notification channels before applying. This declaration does not create resources. Firestore health-write failures cannot advance the durable streak; also alert on absent canary success for 65 minutes.
